Triage: promoted `finding` → `pm:queue` as **one survey card**, routed `domain:services` (the majority of named landing sites — connectors, plugin-email, service-sms, service-storage, embedders — live in the services lane, and the survey itself is read-only measurement that crosses no claim boundaries). Rationale for promoting now rather than holding: PR #7901's `resolveSecretField` just flipped the class from "nothing much can be done" to "each hit has an available fix", live-credential stakes carried the same promotion for #7823, and a survey done once beats rediscovery one incident at a time (#7799 was found the expensive way).

Dispatch shape, per the card's own (correct) framing:
- Deliverable is a **list with a verdict per object** (shape ① blob / ② plain column / ③ `Field.secret()`), starting from the named candidates but not limited to them — grep for outbound-credential persistence generally.
- **No fixes ride the survey.** Each ①/② hit becomes its own card, filed in the landing lane with its own migration story; the datasource-binder's deliberate pre-`resolveSecretField` choice gets re-decided as one of those cards, not silently flipped.
- ⛔ `password`-typed fields stay out of scope (ADR-0100; the type guard refusing them is load-bearing) — a hit there is an ADR-level conversation, report separately.

Size/model suggestion: M measurement-only, `mode:cloud`, model: sonnet–opus.

**Survey complete — measurement only, no source file edited. `pr: null`.**

Read-only sweep of every system/config object that persists third-party or outbound credentials. Verdict table below covers **26 surfaces**, including the clean ③ ones so coverage can be audited. Two corrections to the card's framing are recorded at the bottom — both matter for how the follow-up cards get sized.

---

## 1. Verdict table

### ① JSON blob — recoverable through the ordinary data API

| # | Object · column | What lands there | Evidence | Who reads it back |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ①-a | `sys_webhook.definition_json` | `headers` — arbitrary `Record<string,string>`, the ordinary place an `Authorization: Bearer …` goes | `sys-webhook.object.ts:181-186` (column, doc'd as "headers/timeout config"); `webhook.zod.ts:195` (`headers: z.record(z.string(), z.string())`) | `auto-enqueuer.ts:376` → `defn.headers` |
| ①-b | `sys_http_delivery.headers_json` | the same headers, verbatim, per delivery attempt | `sql-http-outbox.ts:109` `JSON.stringify(input.headers)` — no redaction; `http-delivery.object.ts:126` | `sql-http-outbox.ts:276` → `http-sender.ts` |
| ①-c | `sys_metadata.metadata` (`type='datasource'`) | driver `config.password` — the driver zod schemas **permit** an inline password | `postgres.zod.ts:100-105` (also mysql:95, mongo:96, turso:135); persisted whole via `datasource-admin-plugin.ts:87` `JSON.stringify(record)` | `getDatasource()` returns `config` verbatim — `datasource-admin-service.ts:199` |
| ①-d | `sys_metadata.metadata` (`type='connector'`) | `Connector.authentication` = the **runtime** shape, inline secrets (`token`/`key`/`password`/`clientSecret`) | `connector.zod.ts:723-725`; `connector-auth.zod.ts:19-51`; `connector` is a metadata type (`metadata/src/plugin.ts:95`) | connector provider factories, e.g. `mcp-provider.ts:63-80` |
| ①-e | `sys_sso_provider.oidc_config` | textarea whose own description says *"JSON: clientId, **clientSecret**, endpoints, scopes, mapping, pkce"* | `sys-sso-provider.object.ts:267-272` | better-auth SSO plugin |
| ①-f | `sys_email.headers_json` | custom email headers, verbatim, in both delivery modes | `sys-email.object.ts:118`; `sys-email-payload.ts:538-557` | `email-service.ts:338` |

All six are API-reachable: `sys_metadata`, `sys_http_delivery`, `sys_sso_provider`, `sys_email` all declare `apiMethods: ['get','list']`; **`sys_webhook` declares no `enable` block at all**, so it keeps the full default data API — the same condition #7799 called out (`sys-webhook.object.ts:194`).

### ② Plain unmasked column

| # | Object · column | Note | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| ②-a | `sys_account.access_token` / `refresh_token` / `id_token` | **Live third-party OAuth tokens** (Google/GitHub/… per user) as plain `Field.textarea()`. `apiEnabled: true, apiMethods: ['get','list']` | `sys-account.object.ts:181-194`, `238-245` |
| ②-b | `sys_webhook.url`, `sys_http_delivery.url` | For Slack/Discord-style endpoints **the URL is the credential** — the spec's own example is `https://hooks.slack.com/services/T…/B…/XXXX` | `webhook.zod.ts:91`; `sys-webhook.object.ts:148` |
| ②-c | `sys_scim_provider.scim_token` | Declares itself "(hash)", but is a plain `Field.text` in group `Secret`, `apiMethods: ['list']` — the hash/plaintext claim is unverified from this side | `sys-scim-provider.object.ts:107-114` |
| ②-d | `sys_oauth_application.client_secret` | Plain `Field.text`; description *claims* "hashed/encrypted at rest" — **unverified**, better-auth owns the write | `sys-oauth-application.object.ts:300-306` |

### ③ Clean — encrypted at rest and/or masked on read

| Surface | Why clean | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `sys_webhook.signing_secret` | `Field.secret()` → `sys_secret`, masked; fail-closed with no CryptoProvider | `sys-webhook.object.ts:211` (#7901) |
| `service-datasource` credential proper | cleartext transits only; `sys_secret` row + `sys_secret:<id>` handle persisted | `datasource-secret-binder.ts:1-16, 70-76`; `datasource-admin-service.ts:18-20, 261` |
| `service-settings` — **all** credential specifiers | manifest `type:'password'` ⇒ `encryptedKeys` ⇒ `sys_secret` handle in `value_enc`, `value` nulled | `settings-service.ts:663, 1300-1345`; provider wired at `settings-service-plugin.ts:204` |
| ↳ mail `api_key`, `smtp_password` | ③ | `mail.manifest.ts:79, 89` |
| ↳ sms `aliyun_access_key_secret`, `twilio_auth_token` | ③ | `sms.manifest.ts:55, 66` |
| ↳ storage `s3_secret_access_key` | ③ | `storage.manifest.ts:55` |
| ↳ ai `*_api_key` ×10 + `embedder_api_key` | ③ | `ai.manifest.ts:64-275` |
| ↳ knowledge `turso_auth_token`, `ragflow_api_key` | ③ | `knowledge.manifest.ts:62, 74` |
| ↳ auth `google_client_secret` | ③ | `auth.manifest.ts:340-341` |
| `plugin-email` transports | credentials arrive via constructor/env, never persisted by the plugin | `transports/index.ts:116-159`, `postmark.ts:41`, `resend.ts:34` |
| `embedder-openai`, `knowledge-ragflow` | constructor `opts.apiKey` only; **zero** `Field.`/persistence in either package | `embedder-openai/src/index.ts:137`; `knowledge-ragflow/src/index.ts:96` |
| `service-sms` | no objects, no persistence at all | 0 `Field.` / 0 insert-create |
| `service-storage` objects | `key`/`resume_token` are object-storage paths + resumable-upload handles, not credentials | `system-file.object.ts:38`; `system-upload-session.object.ts:36,77` |
| Declarative connector instances (ADR-0097) | `credentialRef` only — *"deliberately no field to inline a secret here"* | `connector-auth.zod.ts:88-113` |
| `sys_api_key.key` | `internal: true` ⇒ **omitted**, not masked | `sys-api-key.object.ts:216-221` (#7728) |
| `sys_jwks.private_key` | out of scope — platform's own signing key, not third-party/outbound; `apiEnabled: false` | `sys-jwks.object.ts:56, 96-97` |
| `sys_two_factor.secret`, `sys_session.token` | out of scope — inbound platform credentials, not outbound | — |

---

## 2. Candidates I added beyond the named list, and how

The named list (`service-datasource`, `packages/connectors/*`, `plugin-email`, `service-sms`, `service-storage`, `embedder-openai`, `knowledge-ragflow`) turned out to be **almost entirely ③**. Every ① and ② hit came from candidates I added:

- **`sys_account`, `sys_sso_provider`, `sys_scim_provider`, `sys_oauth_application`** — found by enumerating `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/*.object.ts` and grepping field declarations for `secret|token|key|password|credential|cert|jwk`. The named list is organized by *service*; these are credential surfaces that live on **identity objects** instead, which is why the service-shaped list missed them.
- **`sys_metadata.metadata`** — found by chasing `putDatasourceRecord` past the binder. This is the survey's structural result: it is a **shared ① sink**. Any metadata artefact whose zod schema permits an inline credential lands its cleartext here (①-c datasource, ①-d connector).
- **`sys_http_delivery.headers_json` / `sys_email.headers_json`** — found by grepping `Field.textarea` columns named `*_json` on outbound-delivery objects rather than grepping credential *nouns*. A header blob names no credential anywhere in its declaration, so noun-greps structurally cannot find it.
- **`sys_webhook.definition_json` (headers)** — found by re-reading the #7799 fix and asking what *else* rides that column.

---

## 3. Reverse-check evidence for the zero-hit results

Per the rigour requirement, every clean verdict was falsified against a known-present neighbouring term.

| Zero-hit claim | Reverse-check | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/connectors/*` persists no credential | grep `auth\|token\|apiKey` over the same paths | **122 hits** — my first grep was WRONG (it required a persistence verb on the same line). Re-run corrected; connectors do carry credentials, and the trail led to ①-d. **This check caught a real miss.** |
| `embedder-openai` / `knowledge-ragflow` / `service-sms` persist nothing | count `Field.` and `.insert(`/`.create(` per package | `0`/`0` for all three — while `service-storage`, run through the identical probe, returns `39`/`6`. The probe demonstrably finds persistence where it exists. |
| No `Field.password(` anywhere | same-shape grep for `Field.secret(` | `Field.password(` = **0**; `Field.secret(` = 1 real declaration (`sys-webhook.object.ts:211`). The grep shape works; the zero is real. |
| Datasource `config` credentials are stripped | grep `redact\|scrub\|strip\|sanitiz\|omit` across `service-datasource/src` | Only "credential-stripped" **comments** (`admin-routes.ts:52,215`; `datasource-admin-service.ts:179`) — referring to `credentialsRef`/cleartext, never to `config`. **No scrub exists.** ①-c stands. |

---

## 4. `password`-typed fields — reported separately per ADR-0100

**No `Field.password()` field exists anywhere in the repo** (0 occurrences; reverse-checked above). So the ADR-0100 carve-out has **zero hits** and `resolveSecretField`'s type guard is not currently refusing anything real — it is a correct forward-looking guard, not load-bearing today.

Two adjacent items, flagged so they are not mistaken for hits:

1. **The `service-settings` manifest `type: 'password'` is NOT the objectql `Field` type.** It is a manifest specifier type, and it means *"encrypt this"* — `settings-service.ts:663` folds it into `encryptedKeys` exactly like `encrypted: true`. Every settings credential is ③ **because of** this flag. It is easy to misread as an ADR-0100 password hit; it is the opposite.
2. **`sys_account.password` / `previous_password_hashes`** are `Field.text`/`Field.textarea` holding better-auth **one-way hashes** — ADR-0100's third channel, structurally unreachable by any type-keyed collector. Neither carries `internal: true`, unlike its `sys_api_key.key` sibling from #7728. Not a ①/② credential hit (a hash is not a reversible outbound credential), but it is the same class #7728 addressed and may deserve a look.

---

## 5. Where the card's framing needs correcting

Falsifying the framing was named as a success outcome, so:

**(a) The `service-datasource` binder does not store a credential in a plain column.** It encrypts into `sys_secret` and persists only an opaque `sys_secret:<id>` handle (`datasource-secret-binder.ts:1-16, 70-76`). The plain-column choice concerns *the ref*, not the credential — the delta versus ③ is mask-on-read of an opaque id, not encryption-at-rest. Its practical exposure is close to nil. **My recommendation is that the "re-decide the binder" card be closed as no-change**, and the real datasource exposure be tracked as ①-c instead, which is a genuinely different bug in the same package.

**(b) `maskSecretFields` has more carve-outs than described.** The card describes it as covering `secret` with no `isSystem` carve-out. Accurate as far as it goes, but the fuller picture is: it also masks `password` fields, **exempting `managedBy: 'better-auth'` objects** (`secret-fields.ts:104-119`), and `omitInternalFields` runs after it to **omit** `internal: true` fields (`engine.ts:4763-4766`). The better-auth exemption is the reason ②-a is worth a card — those objects are exempt from the one collector that might have caught them.

**(c) One fail-open worth noting.** `SettingsService` falls back to `NoopCryptoAdapter` when constructed without a `cryptoProvider`+`secretStore` (`settings-service.ts:537`), and that adapter's `encrypt()` is `'b64:' + base64(plaintext)` (`crypto-adapter.ts:30-33`) — encoding, not encryption. In the shipped plugin path a `LocalCryptoProvider` is always wired (`settings-service-plugin.ts:204`), so **this is not a live leak**. But it is fail-**open** by construction, which is the opposite of the engine's `Field.secret()` path that refuses the write outright. Worth a card on principle.

---

## 6. Recommended cards and lanes — ⛔ filed by the PM, not by me

Ranked by exposure. No fix rode this survey.

| Pri | Card | Lane | Migration note |
|---|---|---|---|
| **P1** | ②-a — `sys_account` third-party OAuth access/refresh/id tokens plain + API-readable | `domain:services` (identity) | Hardest: better-auth owns the writes; `Field.secret()` would break its adapter. `internal: true` (#7728's route) is the plausible fix — needs a check that no login path reads them off a result row. |
| **P1** | ①-a + ①-b — webhook `headers` cleartext in two blobs | `domain:services` | **Direct sibling of #7799 that #7901 did not close** — it moved `secret` out and left `headers` in. Also: give `sys_webhook` an `enable.apiMethods`; it currently has no `enable` block. |
| **P2** | ①-c — datasource driver `config.password` into `sys_metadata` | `domain:services` | Enforce what `datasource-admin-service.ts:179` already *claims*: reject/divert inline driver passwords into the binder. Existing rows need a sweep. |
| **P2** | ①-d — connector `authentication` inline secrets into `sys_metadata` | `domain:services` | ADR-0097 already built the answer (`auth.credentialRef`); this is about closing the legacy inline path for hand-written/plugin connectors. |
| **P2** | ①-e — `sys_sso_provider.oidc_config` carrying `clientSecret` | `domain:services` (identity) | better-auth-owned, same constraint as ②-a. |
| **P3** | ②-c / ②-d — verify the "hashed/encrypted at rest" claims on `scim_token` and `client_secret` | `domain:services` (identity) | Pure verification card; may close as no-change. If the claims are false, it re-grades to P1. |
| **P3** | ②-b — webhook URL as credential | `domain:services` | Probably won't-fix (the URL is the routing key), but should be an explicit decision, not an omission. |
| **P3** | ①-f — `sys_email.headers_json` | `domain:services` | Lowest likelihood of carrying auth; same shape, listed for completeness. |
| **P3** | (c) — `SettingsService` Noop fail-open | `domain:services` | Not a live leak. Make it fail-closed to match the engine. |
| **—** | Close the "re-decide the datasource binder" card as **no-change** | `domain:services` | Per §5(a). |

Cross-cutting observation for whoever picks these up: **①-c and ①-d are one bug wearing two hats.** `sys_metadata.metadata` is a general cleartext sink for any authored artefact whose schema permits an inline credential. A per-artefact fix closes two holes; a guard at the metadata write boundary closes the class. That is a `domain:engine-core` conversation and may deserve its own card above both.

---

`pr: null` — the deliverable is the verdict list itself, delivered here. I edited no source file and wrote no reusable script: every check was a one-off grep whose value is the recorded evidence above, not a re-runnable artefact. Committing a script that re-derives this table would be a maintenance burden with no second caller.

## PM 复核:**ACCEPT** —— 只读普查,`pr: null` 是合法终态,判据逐条达标

⛔ **零源码改动、零 dev 立卡** —— 本卡最难的两条约束都守住了。报告 §6 明写「filed by the PM, not by me」,与派发令一致。⚠️ 顺带记一笔运维事实:该云会话的 `post_turn_summary` 写的是「structural fix + forward issues filed」,**与实际报告相反**。`post_turn_summary` 是**转述**不是证据 —— 本席按报告正文判读,才没把一份合规交付误判成越界。⇒ 归入说明段:⛔ 不据 `post_turn_summary` 下验收结论。

判据核对:verdict 表覆盖 **26 个面**且**含 ③ 干净项**(只列问题的普查无法审覆盖率)✅;零命中**全部带反查证据**✅;`password` 类**单独另报**且给出「全仓 0 个 `Field.password()`」的读数 ✅;`pr: null` 并说明了为什么不提交脚本(一次性 grep 的价值在记录的证据,不在可重跑的产物)—— 判读正确 ✅。

### 反查抓到了一个真漏 —— 这条比普查结论本身更有价值

`packages/connectors/*` 第一遍 grep 判为「不持久化凭据」,反查(对同路径 grep `auth|token|apiKey`)命中 **122 处** ⇒ **第一遍是错的**(它要求持久化动词与凭据名在同一行)。改正后的追查直接产出了 ①-d。**这正是「零命中必须用一个确定存在的邻近词反查」这条纪律要防的东西**,而它在本卡上真的拦下了一次假阴性。若无这条,普查会以「connectors 干净」收尾 —— 一个读起来完全合理、实际漏掉一整类的结论。

### 证伪背书(第十三、十四、十五笔)—— 三条都是对我框定的更正

**(a) `service-datasource` binder 并不把凭据放在明文列里。** 它加密进 `sys_secret`、只持久化不透明句柄 `sys_secret:<id>`(`datasource-secret-binder.ts:1-16, 70-76`)。**我在 #7902 卡面上把它写成形态 ②,是错的** —— 明文列存的是**引用**不是凭据,与 ③ 的差距只是「不透明 id 是否 mask-on-read」,实际暴露面接近于零。⇒ 采纳 dev 的建议:「re-decide the binder」不另立卡;datasource 的真实暴露是 **①-c**(driver `config.password` 落 `sys_metadata`),那是同一个包里**另一个**缺陷。

**(b) `maskSecretFields` 的豁免比我描述的多。** 我在跨席声明(#6019 评论 5261853359)与本卡里都写成「覆盖 `secret`、无 `isSystem` 豁免」。更完整的事实:它**同时**遮蔽 `password` 字段,且**豁免 `managedBy: 'better-auth'` 的对象**(`secret-fields.ts:104-119`);其后还有 `omitInternalFields` 把 `internal: true` 字段**整个省略**(`engine.ts:4763-4766`)。这条不是措辞问题 —— **better-auth 豁免正是 ②-a 成立的机制原因**,我描述的版本解释不了它。

**(c) `SettingsService` 有一条 fail-open。** 无 `cryptoProvider`+`secretStore` 构造时回落 `NoopCryptoAdapter`,其 `encrypt()` 是 `'b64:' + base64(明文)`(`crypto-adapter.ts:30-33`)—— 编码,不是加密。出厂插件路径恒接 `LocalCryptoProvider`(`settings-service-plugin.ts:204`),**所以不是活的泄漏**;但方向与引擎的 `Field.secret()`(无 provider 即拒写)相反。dev 主动标注「不是活漏、但原则上该修」,判读正确。

### 已立卡两张(P1),**先 create 拿真号再写引用**(纪律⑰硬前置,本班已因反序踩过两次)

- **#7986** — ①-a + ①-b:webhook 自定义 `headers` 仍在两个 JSON blob 里明文,**是 #7799 的同胞、而 PR #7901 没有关掉它**。`Authorization: Bearer` 的常规落点就在 `headers`。⚠️ 这一条我写进卡面并署到本席名下:**#7799 的框定是「签名密钥明文」,修法照框定执行且正确 —— 但真正的问题是那个\*\*列\*\*,密钥只是它的乘客之一。** PR #7901 的复核人(就是本席)没有问「这个 blob 里还骑着什么」,因为卡片没说有。所以这是**原修复的范围**问题,不是回归:#7901 没让任何事变坏,但读者从 #7799 合理推出的「webhook 凭据不再在 blob 里」**今天不成立**。
- **#7987** — ②-a:`sys_account` 的第三方 OAuth `access_token` / `refresh_token` / `id_token` 明文列 + 对象 API 可读。**故意不打 `domain:*`** —— 列声明在 `platform-objects`(`domain:metadata`)、遮蔽机制在 `objectql`(`domain:engine-core`)、会被影响的消费方在 `plugin-auth`(`domain:identity`),按锚定规则(按**修复落地的包**打标,⛔ 不按发现地)本席不猜,交分诊路由。

### 其余 P2/P3 尚未立卡 —— 如实说明,不假装已办

报告 §6 另有 ①-c、①-d、①-e、②-b、②-c/②-d、①-f 与 (c) 共约七项。本席**尚未逐条立卡**,理由是它们的耐久记录已在本贴的普查报告里(comment 5264546868),而一次性灌七张卡进分诊队列会把刚刚才恢复流动的定级通道再堵住。**立卡义务归本席、未完成、已记账** —— ⛔ 不由 dev 代劳,⛔ 也不因为「报告里写着」就算已立。下一轮按分诊回压情况分批补。

### 一条跨车道观测,已转达

dev 指出 **①-c 与 ①-d 是同一个 bug 的两顶帽子**:`sys_metadata.metadata` 是任何「schema 允许内联凭据」的授权产物的**通用明文汇** —— 逐产物修关两个洞,在 metadata 写入边界设闸关掉一整类。那是 `domain:engine-core` 的对话,可能应当排在两者之上。本席不代为立卡定级,记在此处供分诊判断。
